title: Impersonal and passive se: what was closed, suspended and asked for

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know *se* with a verb from B1 Unit 6: *se prohibieron* leaves out who acted (*Se busca una persona*, *se buscan personas*). It is the natural way to list what a government did without naming everyone: what was closed, suspended or asked for.

items.spanish: Se cerró el Congreso y se suspendió la actividad de los partidos políticos.
items.english: Congress was closed and the activity of the political parties was suspended.

items.spanish: Se pidieron muchos préstamos al exterior.
items.english: Many loans were requested from abroad.

items.spanish: Se anunciaron elecciones, y en octubre de 1983 se votó.
items.english: Elections were announced, and in October 1983 people voted.

items.spanish: Se prohibieron los partidos políticos en varios países.
items.english: Political parties were banned in several countries.

sections.content: With a noun, the verb agrees with it: *se cerró el Congreso*, *se pidieron préstamos*. When nobody is named, the actor stays hidden; for the actor use an ordinary verb: *la junta cerró el Congreso*.
